Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Jammu Young Professional recruitment is 30th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Young Professional post is a Master's Degree in Sociology, Psychology, Cultural Studies, or any allied field of the Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional position is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/PwD and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 40,000.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Young Professional post in the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Jammu Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIT Jammu Young Professional recruitment will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Young Professional positions are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Jammu Young Professional recruitment can be found on the official website of IIT Jammu. A direct link to the PDF is also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Jammu and Kashmir. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification to confirm if candidates from other states can apply.
